scope: local-only backup manifest path admission hardening

change.implementation: scripts/backup.mjs rejects C0 and DEL control characters in manifest file paths
change.boundary: restore fails closed before creating a destination when a path can inject log lines or create cross-tool parsing ambiguity
change.negativeFixture: a canonical manifest whose first path contains an embedded newline

limitations: Control-character rejection prevents path-transport ambiguity but does not cryptographically authenticate or sign a manifest.
Independent review, off-host retention, staging drills and production rollback remain separately gated.
